mapper.select: select count(1) from Pe_Meeting_Approval mn where
select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Pe_Meeting_Approval mn left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Ma_Id where mn.Ma_Id=#{maId}
mapper.update: update Pe_Info set Pe_State=#{params.peState} where Pe_id in(select Pe_Id from Pe_Meeting_Approval_List where Ma_Id=#{params.maId});
